bosom.line: My lover comes to me with a rose on her bosom
bosom.lineNext: The moon is dancin' purple all through her black hair
stanza: My lover comes to me with a rose on her bosom
The moon is dancin' purple all through her black hair
And her ladies-in-waiting, she'll stand 'neath my window
And the sun will rise soon on the false and the fair
